Mockups of the card-image area on Virtual card pages, for Bill's question about showing the full-card composite and the slip (swccg-guild/work#1293). Each page is a copy of a live card page with only the image area changed; it uses a sandbox copy of the card template, [[User:Comlink Cursor/Mockups/Card]], and no live page or template is changed. The buttons work for every reader, with no site script change.
